title: Sewing Machine Operators
description: Operate or tend sewing machines to join, reinforce, decorate, or perform related sewing operations in the manufacture of garment or nongarment products.

tasks.text: Monitor machine operation to detect problems such as defective stitching, breaks in thread, or machine malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.

tasks.text: Place spools of thread, cord, or other materials on spindles, insert bobbins, and thread ends through machine guides and components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Position items under needles, using marks on machines, clamps, templates, or cloth as guides.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Guide garments or garment parts under machine needles and presser feet to sew parts together.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Maneuvering workpieces needs hands-on control

dwas.name: Maneuver workpieces in equipment during production.

tasks.text: Remove holding devices and finished items from machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing parts from equipment is hands-on

dwas.name: Remove accessories, tools, or other parts from equipment.
Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Match cloth pieces in correct sequences prior to sewing them, and verify that dye lots and patterns match.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Vision AI assists but physical comparison is human

dwas.name: Compare physical characteristics of materials or products to specifications or standards.

tasks.text: Fold or stretch edges or lengths of items while sewing to facilitate forming specified sections.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Adjusting fabric is tactile manual work

dwas.name: Adjust fabrics or other materials during garment production.

tasks.text: Cut excess material or thread from finished products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Select supplies such as fasteners and thread, according to job requirements.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Select production input materials.

tasks.text: Examine and measure finished articles to verify conformance to standards, using rulers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Start and operate or tend machines, such as single or double needle serging and flat-bed felling machines, to automatically join, reinforce, or decorate material or articles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating sewing equipment is manual machine work

dwas.name: Operate sewing equipment.

tasks.text: Record quantities of materials processed.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Turn knobs, screws, and dials to adjust settings of machines, according to garment styles and equipment performance.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating sewing equipment is manual machine work

dwas.name: Operate sewing equipment.

tasks.text: Attach tape, trim, appliques, or elastic to specified garments or garment parts, according to item specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Attaching accessories requires manual fitting

dwas.name: Attach decorative or functional accessories to products.

tasks.text: Repair or alter items by adding replacement parts or missing stitches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Textile repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Repair textiles or apparel.

tasks.text: Perform equipment maintenance tasks such as replacing needles, sanding rough areas of needles, or cleaning and oiling sewing machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Replace worn equipment components.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Mount attachments, such as needles, cutting blades, or pattern plates, and adjust machine guides according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating sewing equipment is manual machine work

dwas.name: Operate sewing equipment.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Cut materials according to specifications, using blades, scissors, or electric knives.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fabric cutting needs manual dexterity

dwas.name: Cut fabrics.

tasks.text: Inspect garments, and examine repair tags and markings on garments to locate defects or damage, and mark errors as necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Garment defect inspection needs physical handling

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.
Inspect garments for defects, damage, or stains.

tasks.text: Attach buttons, hooks, zippers, fasteners, or other accessories to fabric, using feeding hoppers or clamp holders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Attaching accessories requires manual fitting

dwas.name: Attach decorative or functional accessories to products.

tasks.text: Position material or articles in clamps, templates, or hoop frames prior to automatic operation of machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Draw markings or pin appliques on fabric to obtain variations in design.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Tape or twist together thread or cord to repair breaks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Textile repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Repair textiles or apparel.

tasks.text: Baste edges of material to align and temporarily secure parts for final assembly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Position and mark patterns on materials to prepare for sewing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical alignment of patterns on workpieces

dwas.name: Position patterns on equipment, materials, or workpieces.
Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Perform specialized or automatic sewing machine functions, such as buttonhole making or tacking.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating sewing equipment is manual machine work

dwas.name: Operate sewing equipment.
